mcp.notReadyProgram: Not ready: set the program path. Runs whose pipeline uses {{name}} don't start until then.

archived.emptyDetail: Archiving takes a resource out of the lists and pickers. It shows up here, and Restore brings it back.
archived.nothingDetail: Archived resources are hidden from lists and pickers, and the runs that pinned them were stopped. Pick one to see what archiving did and to restore it.
archived.restoreHint: Back in lists and pickers at once · stopped runs stay stopped
archived.stoppedOne: Archiving stopped the run that pinned it, {{runs}}. Restore puts {{name}} back in the lists and pickers as it was; that run stays stopped, so run it again to use it.
archived.stopped: Archiving stopped {{count}} runs that pinned it, {{runs}}. Restore puts {{name}} back in the lists and pickers as it was; those runs stay stopped, so run them again to use it.
archived.stoppedNone: Archiving stopped no runs. Restore puts {{name}} back in the lists and pickers as it was.
archived.title: Archived: hidden from lists and pickers
